findings.title: Guard on the intermediate product refuses totals that are exactly representable
findings.why: assertSafeTotal(scaled) tests full*90+50, not the final total. For a long stay where full*90+50 exceeds Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER but the discounted result is safe (roughly full between MAX/90 and MAX), quote() and book() throw 'too large to be computed exactly' even though the true total is exact. The new 'big' test case (3 days at floor(MAX/90)+1 per day) asserts exactly this refusal. The error message is misleading, and spec 003 sets no such limit.
